lines.zh: 木轮压过地面,吱呀作响
lines.en: My wooden wheels creak across the ground.

lines.zh: 我被推着挪向新的射位
lines.en: I am pushed toward a new firing position.

lines.zh: 支架在地上拖出两道痕
lines.en: My frame drags two furrows in the soil.

lines.zh: 我的弩臂在行进中微微晃
lines.en: My arms sway slightly as I move.
I go only where I am pushed.

lines.zh: 轮子陷进软土,又爬出来
lines.en: My wheels sink into soft soil and climb out.
The ropes pull taut, and I advance.
I cross a stretch of broken brick.
My axle turns half a round, then stops.

lines.zh: 我被安置在墙的缺口旁
lines.en: I am set down by the gap in the wall.
The ground is uneven; I tilt a little.

lines.zh: 我朝目标的方向转过去
lines.en: I am turned toward the target.
My arms stand cocked, doing nothing.
The rope has slackened half an inch.
I wait for someone to wind me.
A nail in my frame is loose.
My string stays taut.
The wind passes through my groove.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里没那么显眼
lines.en: I am less obvious in the shade.
I hear someone counting bolts.
Sawdust has fallen around me.

lines.zh: 我这种器械,本来不该开口
lines.en: A machine like me should not speak.
I am braced against a stone.
Without a push, I do not move.

lines.zh: 我等一个值得放箭的东西
lines.en: I wait for something worth a shot.

lines.zh: 我的弩臂在阳光下发亮
lines.en: My arms shine in the sun.
You stand in the middle of my arc.
I am only a machine.

lines.zh: 你把手放在我的绞盘上了
lines.en: You have your hand on my winch.
Turn it, and I move.
I wait while you decide whom to shoot.
Your hands are very steady.
I am claimed; I am yours.

lines.zh: 你能看见我的弦有多紧吗
lines.en: Can you see how taut my string is?
Do not use me as cover.

lines.zh: 我身上有前一个主人的划痕
lines.en: My frame bears the last owner's scratches.
Where will you push me?

lines.zh: 你站在这个角度,会挡住我
lines.en: From that angle, you block me.
I do not understand much speech.
But I know where to point.
Do not let the winch slip.
My base needs levelling.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候,我在等人上弦
lines.en: While you look up, I wait to be wound.
You are standing on my base.
A crack has opened in my beam.
I am off by half a knuckle.
I am knocked back.
My axle has worked loose.
I hear wood breaking.
Repairing me is expensive.
I must be recalibrated.
One of my bolts has flown off.
I can still barely serve.
Do not abandon me like this.
Things like me do not eat.
Put a bolt in; that is more practical.
My winch turned once.
That is not a bolt.
I know the smell of a shaft.
My groove waits to be loaded.

lines.zh: 那东西可以垫我的底座
lines.en: That could shim my base.

lines.zh: 我只对能射出去的感兴趣
lines.en: I care only for what can be fired.
My string is taut and the bolt is set.
Put it in the groove and align it.
You struck my frame.
I tilted slightly, but held.

lines.zh: 我这种器械,撞一下就偏
lines.en: One bump throws off my aim.
You stepped on my wheel.
I can neither retreat nor dodge.
My base slid half a foot.
You clambered over me.
Do not come near my arms.
My beam is as thick as your calf.
One more hit and I must be re-aimed.
I am a siege engine.
This is beyond me.
But I can stand watch for you.

lines.zh: 我的影子能给你遮点风
lines.en: My shadow can break the wind.

lines.zh: 你靠着我的轮子坐下吧
lines.en: Sit against my wheel.
I will not leave from here.

lines.zh: 我的木架上还留着上一位的手印
lines.en: The last owner's handprints remain on my frame.
You may put your hand there too.
With you here, the odds are better.
I will remember this night.
My frame cannot hold things.

lines.zh: 你把东西塞进我的凹槽
lines.en: You wedge something into my groove.
This is hardly a bolt.
No use to me, but I keep it.
It is caught in my axle.
You shim it under my base.
Now I sit steadier.
I press my weight onto it.
It looks somewhat useful.
Remember to take it when you go.
I have seen it.
My arms swing to face it.
The calculation is done.
It is on my arc.
This angle will work.
I need someone on the winch.
The rope is at full tension.
This shot will pierce two plates.

lines.zh: 距离、风向、高度,都对上了
lines.en: Range, wind, elevation: all aligned.
It has not moved; good.
I lower the groove by a hair.
You may loose now.
I am fully locked.
That one is my target.
Everyone be ready.
Loose it now if you are going to.
I am turning with it.
My arc is wide.

lines.zh: 它往左,我的支架就往左偏
lines.en: It goes left; my base leans left.
My string begins to hum.
The angle is tightening.
I need one chance.

lines.zh: 这种器械的可怕在于距离
lines.en: What is terrible about me is the distance.
It has gone behind the wall.
I wait for it to come out.
I raise it to clear the parapet.
It runs, but not faster than a bolt.
Wait just a moment more.
My arms are in position.
The wind has shifted half a finger.
I have corrected it back.
This is the quietest moment.
It never saw me at all.
This is very good.
Loose the bolt now.
It is all over now.
The heavy bolt leaves the groove.
The recoil slides my whole frame back.
My arms slam back.
That one went through a shield.
Splinters fly off my frame.
I need to be re-wound.
This bolt can pin two men.
My post rings from the shock.
I slide back half a foot.
Load me another one.
There is no feeling in this blow.
I only shoot forward.
I hear the armour clearly.

lines.zh: 两条弩臂折回来，震得土都跳。
lines.en: My arms snap back and the dirt jumps.
That direction was right.
Let me do that again.
I do not tire of this work.
The wheels are still turning.
I am rolled into the open.
The timbers knock with a dull sound.
My arms are drawn back.
My base lands and bites four holes.
The rope goes taut for the first time.
I face the field squarely.
My wheels are still rocking.

lines.zh: 有人在我身后喊了句什么
lines.en: Someone shouts something behind me.
The timber smells new.
I am aimed at that side.
The winch turns seven rounds.
I am fully prepared.

lines.zh: 我从运输架上被卸下来
lines.en: I am unloaded from the cart.
The ground holds my weight.
My shadow trails long on the ground.
Everyone clear the way.
That great bolt is coming.
This is siege craft.
The wood burns and splits.
I topple off the platform.
Water soaks into my timber.
The blast scatters my base.
An arrow lodges in my groove.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的绳索自己动起来
lines.en: That force moves my ropes by itself.
Without bolts, I am only wood.
Lightning strikes my arms.

lines.zh: 没有地面,我的轮子空转
lines.en: No ground; my wheels spin freely.
